watchOrderBook.description: equal timestamps, zero deletes and reconnect snapshot reset

watchTicker.description: market summary: mark and index, and the book mid as close and last, since the summary has no last trade price

watchTrades.description: settled executions in subscription and update envelopes

watchOHLCV.description: newest candle snapshot, then updates replace the candle with the same t

watchBalance.description: rUSD margin of the configured account; frames for other accounts resolve nothing
spot balances of the SPOT account: a snapshot, then an update of one asset; each all free

watchPositions.description: each frame replaces the configured account positions; an empty frame closes them

watchOrders.description: open orders snapshot, then order events of the configured account; other accounts and FEED_RESET rows resolve nothing
a symbol watch resolves only for that market
spot orders of the SPOT account on the wallet order channel

watchMyTrades.description: recent executions snapshot, then executions of the configured account as maker or taker
a symbol watch resolves only for that market
spot fills of the SPOT account; fills of other accounts are dropped
perpetual fills only: a spot fill in the shared cache, from the spot channel, is left out

createOrderWs.description: perpetual order sent over the order-entry socket and correlated by nonce
spot order from the SPOT account over the order-entry socket

editOrderWs.description: modify with the immutable fields restated by the caller

cancelAllOrdersWs.description: spot cancel-all over the order-entry socket
